meta.title: The Test of Truth
meta.logline: Addisu must choose between staying silent for a respected family elder and speaking the truth to save an innocent man.

style.block: cinematic Ethiopian film still, warm golden lighting, rich earth tones, realistic photography look, detailed textures, traditional Ethiopian clothing and setting, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, expressive faces, subject centered in frame
style.palette: warm earth tones: ochre, sienna, deep brown, golden amber, olive green
style.lighting: warm golden hour natural light, soft shadows, rim lighting on faces
style.reference_sheet_prompt: Character turnaround reference sheet showing four Ethiopian family members side by side in warm natural light on a neutral textured backdrop: (1) Ethiopian father late 40s with short grey-flecked beard in white traditional gabi shawl, (2) 8-year-old Ethiopian boy Young Addisu in earth-toned cotton shirt, (3) 25-year-old East African Ethiopian man Addisu with short curly Afro hair in clean white embroidered Ethiopian shirt, (4) dignified Ethiopian elder late 60s with full grey beard in white gabi. Consistent realistic cinematic portrait style, clear faces, warm earth tones.

characters.name: Addisu's Father
characters.description: East African Ethiopian man in his late 40s with medium-dark brown skin, kind weathered face with short grey-flecked beard, wearing a white traditional gabi shawl over an earth-toned shirt, calm wise expression, deep brown eyes

characters.name: Young Addisu
characters.description: East African Ethiopian boy about 8 years old with brown skin, bright curious dark eyes, short tight curly Afro hair, wearing a simple light brown cotton shirt, earnest expression

characters.name: Addisu
characters.description: East African Ethiopian man in his mid-20s with brown skin, same warm eyes as Young Addisu, short curly Afro hair, clean-shaven jawline, wearing a clean white traditional Ethiopian cotton shirt with subtle woven border, calm determined expression

characters.name: The Elder
characters.description: East African Ethiopian man in his late 60s with medium-dark brown skin, grey hair and full grey beard, wearing a distinguished white gabi shawl, proud bearing with worried eyes

shots.image_prompt: Wide establishing shot of a peaceful Ethiopian highland village at golden hour, traditional tukul houses with thatched roofs on a green hillside, a large acacia tree in the center foreground casting long shadows, warm amber sunset light, an Ethiopian father and his 8-year-old son sitting together under the tree on a wooden bench, centered composition
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle push-in toward the father and son under the tree, soft breeze moving the leaves, warm golden sunlight
shots.narration_amharic: አዲሱ ገና ልጅ እያለ፣ አባቱ በየቀኑ ሁለት ቃሎችን ይነግረው ነበር።
shots.narration_english: When Addisu was still a boy, his father reminded him of two words every day.
shots.reason: Establishes the peaceful setting and the father-son bond that drives Addisu's life
shots.music_cue: Gentle krar melody begins, warm and intimate

shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up centered framing of an Ethiopian father and his young son sitting side by side outdoors, the father looking at his son with warmth and seriousness, his hand resting gently on the boy's shoulder, golden hour light on their faces, soft blurred village behind
shots.motion_prompt: Very subtle camera drift, the father speaks gently while the boy listens and nods slowly, warm natural light
shots.narration_amharic: አዲሱ ልጄ፣ አዛውንቶችን አክብር፤ ሁልጊዜም ለእውነት ቁም።
shots.narration_english: Addisu my son, respect your elders, and always stand for the truth.
shots.reason: Delivers the two core teachings directly to young Addisu
shots.music_cue: Krar melody continues gently, a warm masinko note enters

shots.image_prompt: Centered close-up portrait of Addisu standing outdoors at golden hour, thoughtful determined expression, wearing a clean white traditional Ethiopian cotton shirt, soft blurred Ethiopian highland landscape behind him
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle camera pan past Addisu as he looks thoughtfully into the distance, soft breeze in his clothes
shots.narration_amharic: ዓመታት አለፉ። አዲሱ አደገ፤ የአባቱን ምክር ግን አልረሳም።
shots.narration_english: Years passed. Addisu grew up, never forgetting his father's counsel.
shots.reason: Time transition — shows Addisu has grown while carrying his father's words
shots.music_cue: Music swells softly, a sense of time passing

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a traditional East African Ethiopian family gathering inside a warm clay-walled village home, Ethiopian men and women with brown skin wearing white traditional cotton netela and gabi shawls seated in a circle on wooden stools around a low mesob basket table with a black clay Ethiopian jebena coffee pot and tiny white handleless sini cups, warm sunlight streaming through a wooden window, tense worried faces, centered composition
shots.motion_prompt: Locked-off camera with subtle push-in, people shifting uncomfortably in silence, dust motes in window light
shots.narration_amharic: አንድ ቀን በቤተሰብ ስብሰባ ላይ ገንዘብ ጠፋ።
shots.narration_english: One day, at a family gathering, money went missing.
shots.reason: Sets up the inciting incident inside the close-knit family gathering
shots.music_cue: Music shifts to a minor mode, tension quietly entering

shots.image_prompt: Centered medium shot inside the Ethiopian mud-plastered home of an innocent adult Ethiopian man in his early 30s with dark brown skin and short curly hair sitting with bowed head looking hurt and bewildered while others look suspicious, Addisu watching anxiously from the side, dramatic warm window side lighting
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in toward the accused relative's downcast face while shadows deepen slightly
shots.narration_amharic: ንጹሕ ሰው ተከሰሰ። አዲሱ ግን እውነቱን ያውቅ ነበር።
shots.narration_english: An innocent man was blamed. Yet Addisu knew the truth.
shots.reason: Shows the injustice directly — creates empathy for the accused man and urgency for Addisu
shots.music_cue: Tension deepens, low sustained masinko drone

shots.image_prompt: Centered close-up of the Ethiopian Elder in a dim doorway corner, grey beard and white gabi, leaning slightly forward with anxious pleading eyes, speaking quietly in secret, warm chiaroscuro rim lighting showing fear rather than malice
shots.motion_prompt: Very slow push-in on the elder's worried face, subtle breathing and nervous eye movement
shots.narration_amharic: የወሰደው የአንድ ሽማግሌ ልጅ ነበር። ሽማግሌውም አዲሱን፣ እባክህ ዝም በል አሉት።
shots.narration_english: The elder's own son had taken it. Please stay silent, the elder pleaded with Addisu.
shots.reason: Humanizes the elder as afraid of shame rather than evil, crystallizing Addisu's dilemma
shots.music_cue: Music drops to sparse, quiet, uneasy notes

shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up of Addisu sitting alone on a stone wall outside at dusk, hands clasped, head slightly bowed in deep inner conflict, fading amber sunset light behind him casting long cool shadows
shots.motion_prompt: Static camera, Addisu slowly lifts his gaze toward the horizon, gentle evening wind moving his clothes
shots.narration_amharic: አዲሱ ተጨነቀ። ሽማግሌውን ያክብር ወይስ እውነቱን ይናገር?
shots.narration_english: Addisu was torn. Should he honor the elder, or speak the truth?
shots.reason: The emotional heart of the film — the audience shares the weight of Addisu's conflict
shots.music_cue: Sparse single krar notes with thoughtful space between them

shots.image_prompt: Centered low-angle medium shot inside the Ethiopian mud-walled family gathering room as Addisu rises calmly to his feet, steady quiet resolve on his face, seated Ethiopian family members in white cotton shawls softly blurred around him looking up
shots.motion_prompt: Slow upward tilt as Addisu stands steadily, calm and composed in a still room
shots.reason: Silent dramatic turning point — quiet courage without anger before he speaks
shots.music_cue: Brief silence, then a single clear resolute note

shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up inside the warm mud-walled Ethiopian village room of Addisu standing respectfully as he speaks with gentle steady eyes and quiet dignity, wearing his white traditional Ethiopian cotton shirt with subtle woven chest placket, seated Ethiopian family members softly blurred behind him
shots.motion_prompt: Very gentle push-in on Addisu's calm sincere face as he speaks respectfully
shots.narration_amharic: አዲሱ ተነስቶ፣ አከብርዎታለሁ አለ። ግን ንጹሕ ሰው ሲበደል ዝም አልልም።
shots.narration_english: Rising calmly, Addisu said: I respect you, yet I cannot watch an innocent suffer.
shots.reason: The synthesis — Addisu honors both teachings simultaneously through respectful courage
shots.music_cue: Warm krar and washint return gently, rising with quiet strength

shots.image_prompt: Centered wide shot inside the warm clay-walled Ethiopian village home bathed in warm morning light from the open doorway, Addisu in his white traditional Ethiopian cotton shirt with woven chest placket standing calmly beside the dignified grey-bearded East African Ethiopian Elder in a white gabi, East African Ethiopian family members seated in white cotton shawls nodding slowly in quiet relief and peace
shots.motion_prompt: Slow gentle pull-out revealing the room bathed in warm light as tension dissolves
shots.narration_amharic: እውነቱ ወጣ፤ ንጹሑም ሰው ነፃ ሆነ።
shots.narration_english: The truth came out, and the innocent man was cleared.
shots.reason: Shows the consequence of moral courage — justice and restored harmony
shots.music_cue: Music resolves into warm major harmony

shots.image_prompt: Centered medium close-up of Addisu standing beneath the same village acacia tree at golden hour, peaceful thoughtful expression, warm sunset rim light wrapping around him and the village hills behind
shots.motion_prompt: Slow dolly back revealing the acacia tree and peaceful village bathed in golden hour light
shots.narration_amharic: አዲሱ ተረዳ፤ ማክበር ማለት ስህተትን መደበቅ አይደለም።
shots.narration_english: Addisu understood: respect never means hiding a mistake.
shots.reason: Visual echo of the opening tree shot — ties childhood teaching to Addisu's adult wisdom
shots.music_cue: Opening krar theme returns fully and gently fades

shots.image_prompt: Minimal warm dark umber backdrop with subtle Ethiopian woven geometric border pattern
shots.reason: Delivers the final proverb in Amharic and English along with the required AI disclosure
shots.music_cue: Final sustained krar chord fading smoothly to silence

music.mood: warm nostalgic reflective, shifting to tense then hopeful and resolving peacefully
